key_insight: Evo-RAD turns retrieval for rare retinal disease diagnosis into a self-improving agent that actively removes misleading cases and adds more pathologically consistent evidence.
clinical_relevance: This could improve diagnostic support for rare retinal diseases by reducing false matches from common conditions and making retrieved evidence more disease-homogeneous.
method: Models retrieval as a Markov Decision Process over a support set
Uses actions to DELETE discordant cases, INSERT consistent cases, or TERMINATE
Trains the agent with GRPO and a homogeneity-aware reward
evidence_signal: On retinal disease benchmarks, the method improved rare-disease diagnosis by +21.04% over retinal foundation models and by +3.56% over retrieval-based and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on benchmark quality and the reliability of the retrieved reference set, so real-world deployment would need careful validation.
paper_title: Evo-RAD: Navigating Rare Retinal Disease Diagnosis via Self-Evolving Agentic Retrieval
